title: Cancelling a Circle Membership and the Dues Refunded
content:
## Your cancellation and what comes back

A cancellation of a Northbeam Circle Membership is carried into the membership record only against a
change request standing as confirmed by the customer for that membership. The confirmation is read from
the change request recorded against that membership, with its request type and its outcome, before the
cancellation is carried into the record; it is the customer's own act, on an active membership or on one
whose dues are still outstanding, and a statement on the call that the customer is content to end the
membership is not that record.

Benefits stop on the day the cancellation takes effect, unspent benefit credit is written off, and live
points are swept after the sweep rules.

## When dues come back in full

Dues are refunded in full only when the cancellation is confirmed within the tier's full refund window,
counted from the day the membership was activated. The full refund window is counted in calendar days from
the activation day, which counts as day zero, and the last day of the window itself qualifies. The
activation day is read from the membership record.

## After the full refund window

After that window the tiers that refund pro rata refund the whole unused months of the term at the dues
actually billed, rounded as the tier's proration rounding states, and the tiers that do not refund pay
nothing back.

## What is never refunded

An enrolment fee, a late fee and a reinstatement fee are never refunded, and dues for a period already
used are never refunded.

## How a refund reaches you

A refund is returned to the card the dues were taken from where that card is still on file, and otherwise
posted as store credit.

## Boundary of the full refund window

On Circle Plus Annual, whose full refund window is recorded as 14 days, a cancellation confirmed on the
fourteenth day after activation is inside the window and dues come back in full; one confirmed on the
fifteenth day is outside it, and what comes back is then whatever the tier's recorded refund basis
provides. On a tier
whose window is recorded as 0 days, no day after activation falls inside it.
